answers.Q1: Protocol B, the cream-pad method, had the smallest range: 0.42 mg across weights W-07 through W-12.
answers.Q2: Six bronze register weights were assigned to each protocol: Protocol A W-01 to W-06, Protocol B W-07 to W-12, Protocol C W-13 to W-18.
answers.Q3: Conserva Materials Ltd. manufactured the cream cleaning pad, supplied as lot CM-7; the dossier gives no abrasive grade.
answers.Q4: Three weights received additional soft-bristle brushing after the four-pass sequence: W-04, W-08, and W-16.
answers.Q5: Two blue-pad pieces, W-13 and W-17, were reviewed again because their engraved digits appeared less legible.
answers.Q6: Protocol B had the lowest first-pass median residue mass, 1.18 mg, recorded for the cream-pad group.
